Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses NOTES: · Tender for supply of C-18 Fatty Acid in Bulk and Packed Form on Ex-Works and Delivered Basi s for HPCL Bengaluru. · Total tender quantity: 5,200,000 KG, divided into four schedules. Schedule 1: Bulk C-18 Fatty Acid, Ex-Works – 2,100,000 KG. Schedule 2: Packed C-18 Fatty Acid, Ex-Works – 500,000 KG. Schedule 3: Bulk C-18 Fatty Acid, Delivered – 2,100,000 KG. Schedule 4: Packed C-18 Fatty Acid, Delivered – 500,000 KG. · Two-bid system with Online Reverse Auction. · Evaluation and ranking shall be carried out separately for each schedule based on the lowest e valuated Net Delivered Cost to HPCL. · Order shall be divided between two eligible bidders in the ratio L1: 70% and L2: 30%, subject t o L2 matching the L1 rate and applicable MSE/MII purchase preference provisions. · In case L2 does not accept the counter-offer, 100% quantity shall be placed on L1. · Contract validity shall be one year from the date of PO/GeM Contract/LOA, whichever is earlier . · Delivery shall be completed within 15 days from the respective Release Order/Call-up. · C-18 Fatty Acid shall strictly conform to the technical specifications stipulated in the tender.

· Submission and clearance of two identical one-litre tender samples, along with Certificate of A nalysis, is mandatory. · Bids without sample submission by the tender due date, or where the sample fails HPCL testin g, shall not be considered further. · Every consignment shall be accompanied by CoA, TDS and MSDS, as applicable. · Bulk supply shall be made through suitable 20–40 MT Bulk Tank Trucks. · Packed supply shall be made in new HDPE barrels of 170–210 kg net weight. · For Ex-Works schedules, transportation shall be arranged by HPCL; loading, weighment, sealin g and related documentation shall be in the vendor’s scope. · For Delivered schedules, transportation, transit insurance and delivery at the HPCL-advised lo cation near Bengaluru shall be in the vendor’s scope. · Acceptance and payment shall be subject to the material meeting tender specifications and cl earance by HP Green R&D Centre/authorised HPCL laboratory. · Payment shall be processed within 15 days from submission of correct and complete invoice/d ocuments through HPCL-VSS, subject to laboratory acceptance. · Price escalation/de-escalation shall apply in accordance with the tender’s approved Price Varia tion Clause based on the Wholesale Price Index of Mustard Oil. · Packing, handling, freight, transportation and other incidental charges shall not be subject to price variation. · Bidders shall fulfil the schedule-wise financial and technical PQC and submit the supporting do cuments stipulated in the tender. · Similar work shall mean supply of Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals, Additives, Intermediates or Polymers. · Minimum local content requirement shall be 20%. Only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers shall be eligible to participate. · Schedule-wise EMD shall be ₹1 lakh per schedule, subject to applicable exemptions under the tender. · 2% Security Deposit and 5% CPBG shall apply as per tender conditions. · Corporation does not guarantee any minimum purchase or business against the contract. · Bidders shall upload all PQC documents, declarations, technical compliance statement, local-c ontent undertaking, Integrity Pact and other documents stipulated in the tender. · Unless otherwise specified, in case of conflict, HPCL General Terms and Conditions shall take precedence over GeM General Terms and Conditions. · Bidders are advised to refer to the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document for complete tend er details and requirements. . 3.
